product_metadata.title: New Age Imports, Inc. India Small Decorated Brass Charcoal Screen Incense Burner with Wooden Coaster
features: Immerse yourself in the captivating world of ancient traditions with the New Age Imports, Inc. India Small Decorated Brass Charcoal Screen Incense Burner with Wooden Coaster. This exquisite resin incense burner is meticulously handcrafted from high-quality brass, ensuring both durability and timeless appeal.

The burner's surface is adorned with intricate decorative patterns, showcasing the skillful craftsmanship of artisans. These ornate designs create a mesmerizing visual display, evoking a sense of elegance, mysticism, and cultural richness. As the brass burner gently glows, it adds an enchanting aura to any space, creating a warm and inviting ambiance.

Designed for convenience and ease of use, this incense burner features a charcoal screen. The screen securely holds the resin incense, allowing for optimal air circulation during the burning process. This ensures a steady and controlled burn, releasing the aromatic properties of the incense in a gradual and harmonious manner. Enjoy the captivating scents as they permeate the air, creating a serene and peaceful atmosphere.

The compact size of this burner makes it ideal for personal rituals, meditation sessions, or simply infusing your surroundings with a soothing fragrance. With dimensions of 2.5 inches in length, 2.5 inches in width, it is conveniently sized to fit in the palm of your hand. Its compact nature allows for easy placement on altars, meditation spaces, or any desired area where you seek tranquility.

Available in a striking black color, this incense burner adds an element of sophistication and mystery to any space. The deep black hue beautifully contrasts with the brass accents, enhancing the overall visual appeal. It effortlessly blends with a variety of decor styles, adding an exotic touch and becoming a focal point of admiration.

To ensure stability and protect your surfaces, this burner comes with a wooden coaster. Crafted from fine wood, the coaster complements the burner's aesthetic and adds a natural and rustic element to the overall design. It serves as a practical and decorative base, safeguarding your furniture from heat and residue.

Immerse yourself in the rich heritage and indulge your senses with the New Age Imports, Inc. India Small Decorated Brass Charcoal Screen Incense Burner with Wooden Coaster. Let its captivating beauty, craftsmanship, and functionality elevate your spiritual practices and create a serene sanctuary within your home or sacred space. Note: Please ensure proper safety precautions when using any type of incense burner. Burn your favorite resin incense such as Frankincense, Copal, Benzoin, & Other Resin Church Incense.
